summary: Iteration 3 — Live workout session + Progress page + body-metrics refresh/clear-log verified end-to-end. Backend: 39/39 pytest passing (27 regression from iter2 + 12 NEW iter3 tests for POST/GET/DELETE /api/workouts, /workouts/stats, /exercises/{id}/previous, DELETE /api/body-metrics/{metric}). Frontend: full Hevy-style live session flow verified — login → /workout → Start Empty button navigates to /workout/session/empty with Empty workout placeholder; My Routines tab → Start Routine navigates to /workout/session/{routineId} with 4 exercise cards / 12 set rows / sticky Duration+Volume+Sets pills. Filling kg=60 reps=10 in set 1 and clicking ✓ updated Volume to '600 kg' and Sets to '1'. Add Set added a row (12→13), Notes textarea accepted input, all 4 exercises had rest-timer toggle. Finish opened Save dialog with pre-filled title 'Full Body 3x — Full Body C', clicking Save persisted and navigated to /progress where the card showed '8s 600 kg 1/13 sets' with 4 exercise badges and 4 stat boxes (Workouts 1 / Total Volume 600 kg / Sets 1 / Total Time 8s). Hover-trash delete removed the card (1→0). /body-metrics Refresh button works, profile banner correctly shows 22 yrs / 167 cm / 86 kg / Male, clear-log button removed the body_fat manual log and the card reverted to Estimated badge. Theme toggle still present. No console errors during flows (one pre-existing 401 on auth probe before login is expected).

issues: Trash button is only visible on hover and has no data-testid — for testability consider exposing PROGRESS.deleteButton testid; click target is the last <button> inside the card which works but is fragile.
After clearing a manual log, the card flips to 'Estimated' but the inline numeric value also changes; consider a brief toast confirmation so users notice the source change.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid (e.g., PROGRESS.deleteButton) to the trash button on each workout card so tests don't rely on 'last button' selector.
Optional: success toast after clearing a body-metric log and after deleting a workout.

Not blocking: UI for time-based exercises (cardio/core variant with TIME column + session-time-input) was not exercised because all 3 admin routines use weighted exercises; backend schema supports duration_seconds — confirm via a manual smoke if you add a cardio routine.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:622-652 create_workout aggregates kg*reps correctly only when set.completed AND kg AND reps are all truthy — verified by test producing total_volume_kg=600.0, completed_sets=1, total_sets=6.
server.py:687-709 /workouts/stats aggregation pipeline groups all user sessions correctly; safe-guards for empty result (returns zeros).

server.py:722-734 /exercises/{id}/previous queries by 'exercises.exercise_id' and only returns completed sets — small risk: returns the FIRST exercise entry matching the id, which is fine since multiple entries of the same exercise in one session would be unusual.
server.py:610-618 DELETE /api/body-metrics/{metric} correctly rejects auto metrics (400) and unknown metrics (400); returns {deleted: N} on success.
Auth still uses Bearer or cookie — both paths verified.
WorkoutSessionIn name defaults to 'Workout' but frontend pre-fills with routine name — good UX.

Workout document stores routine_id as plain string (can be None); list_workouts only enriches exercise names+images, not routine names. If you ever rename a routine the past workout will keep the snapshotted name — that's the right behavior.
Backend persists created_at as ISO string (server.py:647) while older docs may have datetime objects — list output mixes types; consider standardizing to datetime + isoformat() at serialization time.
Frontend Workout.jsx still has the stale react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warning per E1 — non-blocking.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_workouts_iter3.py (new, 12 cases — covers create+aggregates, list+enrichment, stats, previous, previous-empty, auth-required, delete, delete-404, clear-log, clear-auto-400, clear-unknown-400, clear-requires-auth)
seed_data_creation: Test left the admin account clean — the workout created during Playwright flow was deleted via the UI trash button; the body_fat manual log was cleared via the UI clear-log button. Profile values left as {22, 167, 86, male} matching iter3 starting state. pytest fixtures restore profile to {28, 178, 75, male} at end of regression suite, but iter3 UI test pushed it back to 22/167/86 inadvertently — if next agent needs exact iter3 starting profile they should re-PUT.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter3 features fully verified. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_workouts_iter3.py + /app/backend/tests/test_lifeos_backend.py as the regression suite (39 cases total, ~5s parallel). Frontend testids confirmed: workout-start-empty-button, workout-start-routine-button (3 instances), session-duration/volume/sets-count/finish-button/discard-button/exercise-card/set-row/kg-input/reps-input/rpe-input/complete-set-button/add-set-button/notes-input/rest-timer-toggle/save-title/save-description/save-submit, progress-workout-card, body-metrics-refresh-button, body-metrics-clear-log-button. Trash button on progress card has NO testid (use card.locator('button').last). The session route accepts either a Mongo ObjectId or the literal 'empty'. Saved workouts pre-fill title with the routine name. Time-based-exercise UI variant (TIME column / session-time-input) NOT exercised because seeded routines only contain weighted exercises.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found in iter3 features. All POST→GET round-trips verified (workout persistence, stats aggregation, exercise.previous, body-metrics clear-log reversion to estimated). One observation worth main agent attention: the trash button on /progress workout cards lacks a data-testid — adding PROGRESS.deleteButton would make automated regression coverage of the delete flow far more robust.
